overall: The AG found insufficient evidence that the Board removed a member of the public from its January 22, 2013 open meeting, so no violation; it issued only a reminder of the right to attend.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Chair ended a discussion when he arrived at a January 2013 meeting and told him to leave, which he said was improper exclusion from an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of such evidence, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
